90b8e4b988602558099b66a5ec8bfd4f4767f745.summary: Analysis of the Kinsing Linux malware's rootkit component, published 24 November 2020. The installer script uses library preloading via /etc/ld.so.preload to hide the malware's files and network connections, sets up service and cron persistence, and the rootkit reuses the public beurk rootkit with custom changes. The report also lists command-and-control IP addresses and file hashes as indicators of compromise.
